title.narrative: Land for Life - Making Policies Work for Food Security, Phase III (LBR)

description.narrative: Impact: Contributing to the improvement of food security through secure land rights in rural communities in Burkina Faso, Ethiopia, Liberia and Sierra Leone.Outcome: Strengthening inclusive, accountable and effective land policy and governance through sustainable, multi-stakeholder processes.

Land for Life Life supports the establishment or strengthening of existing multi-stakeholder partnerships (MAP) on land governance in Burkina Faso, Ethiopia, Liberia and Sierra Leone. The aim is to bring together all relevant stakeholders such as civil society, government, private sector, academia or media, to build trust and collaborate for land-related policy and behavioral change. Especially rights holders and civil society are empowered to participate meaningfully in dialogue and partnerships. Phase III of the initiative builds on the achievements of phase I and II and focuses on the sustainability of the established multi-stakeholder processes and platforms.

There is a direct target group of in total 2.200 people:MAP actors, such as the Land for Life MAP secretariats, i.e. the staff of the partner organizations responsible for the implementation of the initiative, as well as the members of the MAP steering committees and thematic working groups (ca. 100 active members of the MAP committees).Approximately 1500 residents of rural communities will be strengthened and supported in their awareness of existing rights and in their possibilities to claim them. This is achieved through training, community-level dialogues and, as in Burkina Faso, the use of paralegals.
